like_as.sentence: She works ___ a nurse in a public hospital.
like_as.explanation: As indica su profesión real (lo que ES).

like_as.sentence: He swims ___ a fish — he's incredibly fast.
like_as.explanation: Like + noun = similar a. No es un pez, se parece a uno.

like_as.sentence: ___ I told you yesterday, the meeting has been cancelled.
like_as.explanation: As + oración (como te dije). "Like I told you" es muy coloquial y se evita en el examen.

like_as.sentence: ___ it was raining, we decided to stay at home.
like_as.explanation: As = because / since: introduce la razón.

like_as.sentence: Many people regard him ___ the best writer of his generation.
like_as.explanation: Regard + objeto + as.

like_as.sentence: She is ___ tall ___ her older brother.
like_as.explanation: Comparación de igualdad: as + adjetivo + as.

like_as.sentence: My phone is the same ___ yours.
like_as.explanation: Siempre "the same as", nunca "the same like" ni "the same than".

like_as.sentence: He looks ___ he hasn't slept for days.
like_as.explanation: Look + as if / as though + oración = parece como si...

like_as.sentence: You look ___ your mother when you smile.
like_as.explanation: Look like + noun phrase (your mother).

like_as.sentence: I love outdoor sports, ___ climbing and kayaking.
like_as.explanation: Such as = for example; introduce ejemplos.

like_as.sentence: The hotel was described ___ 'luxurious', but it was actually quite basic.
like_as.explanation: Describe + as (como define / regard / consider / know).

like_as.sentence: He talks to me ___ I were a child.
like_as.explanation: As though / as if + were: situación hipotética (no soy un niño).

like_as.sentence: ___ your lawyer, I strongly advise you not to sign this contract.
like_as.explanation: Es realmente su abogado → as (función real).

like_as.sentence: He argues ___ a lawyer, although he's actually a chef.
like_as.explanation: No es abogado, solo se parece a uno → like.

like_as.sentence: That film seems ___ a complete waste of time to me.
like_as.explanation: Seem like + noun phrase.

like_as.sentence: She seems ___ rather upset today.
like_as.explanation: Seem + to be + adjetivo (sentimientos / impresiones).

like_as.sentence: This soup tastes ___ it has been in the fridge for a week. (2 words)
like_as.explanation: Taste (como look) + as if / as though + oración.

like_as.sentence: During the war, the building was used ___ a hospital.
like_as.explanation: Función real del edificio → as.

like_as.sentence: He behaves as if he ___ the boss, but he's just an intern.
like_as.explanation: As if + past simple (were) para algo irreal / hipotético.

like_as.sentence: He was known ___ 'The Iron Man' because of his discipline.
like_as.explanation: Be known as = ser conocido como.

preference.sentence: I prefer walking ___ taking the bus.
preference.explanation: Prefer + V-ing + to + V-ing. Nunca "than".

preference.sentence: I would prefer ___ (stay) at home tonight rather than go out.
preference.explanation: Would prefer + to inf + rather than + inf sin to.

preference.sentence: I'd rather ___ a film than go to the theatre.
preference.explanation: Would rather + infinitivo sin to.

preference.sentence: She'd rather travel alone ___ with a group.
preference.explanation: Would rather + inf + and not + ... para contrastar dos opciones.

preference.sentence: I'd rather you ___ smoke in the house.
preference.explanation: Would rather + otro sujeto + past simple (presente / futuro).

preference.sentence: It's high time we ___ (leave); it's almost midnight.
preference.explanation: It's high time + sujeto + past simple = ya va siendo hora de que...

preference.sentence: I would like ___ Biology at university, but I chose Law instead.
preference.explanation: Deseo ahora sobre algo pasado → would like + to have + participio.

preference.sentence: I would have liked ___ you before you moved to Canada.
preference.explanation: Deseo que tenías en el pasado → would have liked + to inf.

preference.sentence: I'd rather you ___ (not tell) anyone about it yesterday — now everyone knows.
preference.explanation: Would rather + sujeto + past perfect: queja sobre algo pasado.

preference.sentence: Would you sooner ___ in the city or in the countryside?
preference.explanation: Would sooner (= would rather) + infinitivo sin to.

preference.sentence: I'd prefer ___ by train rather than fly.
preference.explanation: Would prefer + to inf.

preference.sentence: She prefers tea ___ coffee.
preference.explanation: Prefer + noun + to + noun.

preference.sentence: I'd rather ___ (not / talk) about it, if you don't mind.
preference.explanation: Negativa: would rather + not + inf sin to.

preference.sentence: I'd rather we ___ the meeting until next week.
preference.explanation: Would rather + sujeto (we) + past simple.

preference.sentence: Come on, children, it's time ___ to bed!
preference.explanation: Sin sujeto: It's time + to inf.

preference.sentence: He'd rather ___ the money than lent it to his brother — he never got it back.
preference.explanation: Mismo sujeto, preferencia sobre el pasado → would rather + have + participio.

preference.sentence: I would hate ___ that exam without studying — luckily I prepared well.
preference.explanation: Sentimiento ahora sobre algo pasado → would hate + to have + participio.

preference.sentence: Would you prefer me ___ you up at the station?
preference.explanation: Would prefer + objeto + to inf.

preference.sentence: I'd sooner ___ (die) than apologise to him!
preference.explanation: Would sooner + inf sin to + than + inf sin to.

preference.sentence: I'd rather you ___ honest with me from the beginning.
preference.explanation: Pasado (from the beginning) y otro sujeto → would rather + past perfect.

past.sentence: When I was a child, I ___ climb trees every afternoon.
past.explanation: Hábito pasado con un verbo de acción → would (o used to).

past.sentence: We ___ live in a small village before moving to Madrid.
past.explanation: Live es un estado / lugar donde vivías → solo used to, no would.

past.sentence: I ___ have long hair when I was at university.
past.explanation: Have (posesión) es un estado → solo used to.

past.sentence: I ___ (sleep) when you called me last night.
past.explanation: Acción larga interrumpida por otra corta → past continuous.

past.sentence: While she ___ dinner, the lights went out.
past.explanation: While + past continuous (acción larga); la corta en past simple.

past.sentence: By the time the police arrived, the thieves ___.
past.explanation: By the time + past simple → la acción anterior va en past perfect.

past.sentence: They ___ (wait) for hours when the bus finally arrived.
past.explanation: Duración antes de otra acción pasada → past perfect continuous.

past.sentence: I ___ the living room — come and see how nice it looks now.
past.explanation: Lo importante es el resultado terminado → present perfect simple.

past.sentence: I'm exhausted. I ___ the living room all morning.
past.explanation: Lo importante es la actividad y su duración → present perfect continuous.

past.sentence: Dinosaurs ___ on Earth millions of years ago.
past.explanation: Hecho del pasado con "ago" → past simple.

past.sentence: The sun ___ and the birds were singing as we set off.
past.explanation: Describir el escenario (background) de una historia → past continuous.

past.sentence: She ___ (visit) Paris last year.
past.explanation: Acción terminada con "last year" → past simple.

past.sentence: I didn't ___ like vegetables, but now I love them.
past.explanation: Negativa: didn't + use to (sin -d).

past.sentence: Before he became famous, he ___ in several small bands.
past.explanation: Before + past simple; la acción anterior → past perfect.

past.sentence: How long ___ English before you moved to London?
past.explanation: Duración antes de otro momento pasado → past perfect continuous.

past.sentence: When I got to the cinema, the film ___ (already / start).
past.explanation: La película empezó antes de que yo llegara → past perfect.

past.sentence: I ___ my keys, so I can't get into the house.
past.explanation: Acción pasada con consecuencia en el presente → present perfect simple.

past.sentence: When I was younger, I ___ love horror films, but now I can't stand them.
past.explanation: Love es un estado / gusto → solo used to, nunca would.

past.sentence: He was exhausted because he ___ all day.
past.explanation: Duración que explica una situación pasada → past perfect continuous.

past.sentence: As a teenager, I ___ (often / play) football every weekend.
past.explanation: Rutina pasada → past simple + adverbio de frecuencia (o used to / would).

transformations.lead_in: My brother is a doctor and he works in a hospital in London.
transformations.explanation: As + profesión real.

transformations.lead_in: He gives the impression that he hasn't slept for days.
answers: as if he has not slept
transformations.explanation: Look + as if + oración.

transformations.lead_in: I'd prefer to stay at home rather than go to the party.
answers: would rather stay at home than
transformations.explanation: Would prefer to... rather than = would rather + inf + than + inf.

transformations.lead_in: I'd rather walk than take the bus.
transformations.explanation: Prefer + V-ing + to + V-ing.

transformations.lead_in: You really should get a job now.
transformations.explanation: It's high time + sujeto + past simple.

transformations.lead_in: Please don't smoke in the car.
transformations.explanation: Would rather + otro sujeto + past simple (negativo: didn't).

transformations.lead_in: It's a pity I didn't study medicine.
transformations.explanation: Deseo ahora sobre el pasado → would like + to have + participio.

transformations.lead_in: I wanted to go to the concert, but I couldn't.
transformations.explanation: Deseo que tenías en el pasado → would have liked + to inf.

transformations.lead_in: The thieves escaped before the police arrived.
transformations.explanation: Past perfect + by the time + past simple.

transformations.lead_in: We started waiting for the bus two hours before it arrived.
transformations.after: two hours when the bus arrived.
transformations.explanation: Duración antes de otra acción pasada → had been + V-ing.

transformations.lead_in: I don't play football every weekend any more.
transformations.explanation: Hábito pasado que ya no ocurre → used to + inf.

transformations.lead_in: She was cooking when the lights went out.
transformations.explanation: While + past continuous.

transformations.lead_in: Most people consider him the best player in the world.
transformations.after: the best player in the world.
transformations.explanation: Be regarded + as (pasiva de regard someone as).

transformations.lead_in: The two jackets cost the same.
transformations.explanation: Igualdad: as + adj + as / the same (price) as.

transformations.lead_in: It's a shame you didn't tell me the truth.
transformations.explanation: Queja sobre el pasado de otra persona → would rather + sujeto + past perfect.

transformations.lead_in: I'd prefer you not to call me after 10 p.m.
transformations.explanation: Would sooner (= would rather) + sujeto + past simple.

transformations.lead_in: When I was a child, I spent every summer at my grandparents' farm.
transformations.before: When I was a child, I
transformations.explanation: Hábito pasado con verbo de acción → would + inf.

transformations.lead_in: I started painting the room this morning and I'm still doing it.
transformations.explanation: Actividad que empezó en el pasado y continúa → present perfect continuous.

transformations.lead_in: It seems that she is rather tired today.
transformations.explanation: Seem + to be + adjetivo.

transformations.lead_in: I regret camping instead of staying in a hotel.
transformations.explanation: Mismo sujeto, preferencia sobre el pasado → would sooner + have + participio.

book.sentence: Larissa can't play tennis this weekend because she ___ her wrist.
book.explanation: Resultado en el presente (no puede jugar) → present perfect.

book.sentence: She ___ while she was running for a train yesterday.
book.explanation: Acción corta que interrumpe a la larga → past simple.

book.sentence: She fell over while she ___ for a train yesterday.
book.explanation: Acción larga en progreso → past continuous.

book.sentence: Could you get me a bandage, please? ___ my finger.
book.explanation: Acción reciente con resultado ahora → present perfect.

book.sentence: While I ___ lunch, my phone rang six or seven times.
book.explanation: While + past continuous.

book.sentence: While I was having lunch, my phone ___ six or seven times.
book.explanation: Acciones cortas repetidas que interrumpen → past simple.

book.sentence: It wasn't the first time Jess ___ the law.
book.explanation: It was the first time... → past perfect.

book.sentence: When she was a child, she ___ sweets in shops.
book.explanation: Hábito pasado (acción) → would.

book.sentence: What time ___ home last night?
book.explanation: Tiempo terminado (last night) → past simple.

book.sentence: Ben ___ computer games all morning. He must be hungry by now.
book.explanation: Actividad hasta ahora con efecto presente → present perfect continuous.

book.sentence: You look pretty rough. ___ any breakfast yet?
book.explanation: Yet → present perfect.

book.sentence: No, I feel terrible. ___ a wink last night.
book.explanation: Last night (terminado) → past simple.

book.sentence: It's Thursday already. ___ online every morning this week.
book.explanation: This week (periodo no terminado) → present perfect.

book.sentence: It's nearly three months since ___ the exams.
book.explanation: It's ... since + past simple (momento concreto).

book.sentence: ___ to wait as long as this before. It's torture.
book.explanation: Experiencia hasta ahora (never ... before) → present perfect.

book.sentence: I'm sure you'll be OK. ___ for months.
book.explanation: Actividad larga hasta ahora → present perfect continuous.

book.sentence: ___ every geography exam I've ever taken.
book.explanation: Experiencia hasta ahora → present perfect.

book.sentence: It could be the message ___ for.
book.explanation: Duración que sigue ahora → present perfect continuous.

book.sentence: Brilliant! ___ Congratulations!
book.explanation: Noticia reciente con resultado ahora → present perfect.

book.sentence: That's amazing — I really thought that ___.
book.explanation: Anterior a otro pasado (I thought) → past perfect.

book.sentence: She ___ (copy) her friend's work for over a year, before one of her teachers found out.
book.explanation: Duración antes de otro momento pasado → past perfect continuous.

book.sentence: The tsunami destroyed the bungalow where they ___ (stay) just two days before.
book.explanation: Antes de otro momento pasado → past perfect (continuo o simple).

book.sentence: It was only after she had arrived that she realised she ___ (forget) to bring her phone charger.
book.explanation: Anterior a 'realised' → past perfect.

book.sentence: You are looking very sweaty. ___ (you / exercise) this morning?
book.explanation: Actividad reciente con efecto visible → present perfect continuous.

book.sentence: I ___ (repair) the gears on my bike, so I can't come with you until I've had a shower.
book.explanation: Actividad reciente con efecto ahora (estoy sucio) → present perfect continuous.

book.sentence: They ___ (drive) for most of the morning when they decided to stop for a picnic.
book.explanation: Duración antes de otra acción pasada → past perfect continuous.

book.sentence: They ___ (go) backpacking to India twice this year.
book.explanation: Número de veces en un periodo no terminado → present perfect simple.

book.sentence: He went home as soon as he ___ (finish) his work.
book.explanation: As soon as / after + past perfect.

book.sentence: My eyes were tired because I ___ (read) for three hours in bad light.
book.explanation: Duración que explica una situación pasada → past perfect continuous.
